MedicalRequest.title: MedicalRequest
MedicalRequest.description: Represents a medical leave request submitted by a student.

id.description: Unique identifier for the medical request.

studentId.description: Reference to the Student who submitted the request. (Relationship: Student 1:N MedicalRequest)

age.description: Age of the student at the time of the request.

dateRequested.description: Date the medical leave was requested.

timeRequested.description: Time the medical leave was requested.

medicalDocuments.description: Array of URIs to the uploaded medical documents.

statusUpdates.description: Array of status updates for the medical request.

doctorVerificationStatus.description: The approval/rejection status from the doctor who is in charge of the document. For example, Approved, Rejected.

directorApprovalStatus.description: The approval/rejection status from the director after the doctor's initial approval. For example, Approved, Rejected.

rejectionReason.description: Reason for rejection, if the request was rejected by the doctor or director.  May be null.

doctorId.description: Reference to the Doctor. (Relationship: Doctor 1:1 DoctorAvailability)

availabilityStatus.description: Availability status of the doctor (e.g., Available, Not Available, Nurse Available, On Leave).

FacultyAvailability.title: FacultyAvailability
FacultyAvailability.description: Represents a faculty member's availability status.

name.description: The name of the faculty member, used as the document ID.

role.description: The role of the person (e.g. Faculty).

AcademicOfficeAvailability.title: AcademicOfficeAvailability
AcademicOfficeAvailability.description: Represents the global availability of the Academic Office.

status.description: Global availability status for the office (e.g., YES, NO).

name.description: The full name of the student.

studentId.description: Unique student identifier, used as document ID.

branch.description: The student's branch (e.g., CSE, ECE, AIDS).

enrolledCourses.description: List of courses the student is enrolled in.

courseAbbr.description: The abbreviation of the course (e.g., DSA, PS).

createdBy.description: Identifier for who created the record.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the record was created.

role.description: The user's role (e.g., student, doctor, director, academic_office, librarian).

createdAt.description: The date and time the user account was created.

subjectsHandled.description: List of subjects handled by the doctor.

Faculty.title: Faculty
Faculty.description: Represents a faculty member in the university.

id.description: Unique identifier for the faculty, used as document ID.

facultyName.description: The full name of the faculty member.

department.description: The department the faculty belongs to.

maxWeeklyHours.description: The maximum number of teaching hours per week for this faculty member.

allowedUGs.description: List of undergraduate years the faculty is allowed to teach.

TeachingAssignment.title: TeachingAssignment
TeachingAssignment.description: Represents the final assignment of a faculty member to a specific course section.

Curriculum.title: Curriculum
Curriculum.description: Represents a single course within a curriculum.

branch.description: The branch this course belongs to (CSE, ECE, AIDS).

courseName.description: The full name of the course.

courseType.description: Type of course (Institute Core, Program Core, etc.).

semester.description: The semester the course is offered in.

credits.description: The number of credits for the course.

description.description: A brief description of the course.

UserShortcut.title: UserShortcut
UserShortcut.description: Represents a user-defined shortcut for the smart search bar.

url.description: The URL the shortcut points to.

Book.title: Book
Book.description: Represents a book in the institute library.

category.description: The category or subject of the book.

description.description: A short description of the book.

fileUrl.description: URL to the book's PDF file.

coverImageUrl.description: URL to the book's cover image.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the book was added.

StudentLibraryFile.title: StudentLibraryFile
StudentLibraryFile.description: Represents a file in a student's personal library.

type.description: The MIME type of the file.

folder.description: The folder this file belongs to. Can be 'root'.

uploadedAt.description: Timestamp of when the file was uploaded.

GlobalResource.title: GlobalResource
GlobalResource.description: Represents a global resource link visible to all students.

name.description: The display name of the resource (e.g., 'GitHub', 'Striver DSA Sheet').

url.description: The URL the resource points to.

description.description: A short description of the resource.

StudentResource.title: StudentResource
StudentResource.description: Represents a personal resource saved by a student.

url.description: URL to the stored file or external link.

folder.description: The folder this resource belongs to. Can be 'root'.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the resource was added.

studentId.description: Reference to the Student who submitted the complaint (for internal audit only).

hostelName.description: The name of the hostel (e.g., Boys Hostel 1, Girls Hostel 2).

description.description: A detailed description of the complaint.

attachments.description: Array of URIs to uploaded images or files.

submittedAt.description: Timestamp of when the complaint was submitted.

status.description: The current status of the complaint.

internalNotes.description: Internal notes visible only to SLC members.

Event.title: Event
Event.description: Represents a campus event created by the SDC.

organizer.description: The club or organizer of the event.

description.description: A detailed description of the event.

eventDate.description: The date and time of the event.

posterImageUrl.description: Optional URL to the event's poster image.

eventType.description: The type or category of the event.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the event was created.

SemesterPolicy.title: SemesterPolicy
SemesterPolicy.description: Defines the academic rules and constraints for timetable generation for a specific semester.

hasElectives.description: Whether this semester offers elective courses.

usesStudentPreferences.description: Whether student preferences are considered for elective allocation.

usesCGPA.description: Whether CGPA is used as a factor in course allocation.

numberOfElectiveBins.description: The number of elective bins available.

maxTimetableRetries.description: The maximum number of attempts the scheduler should make.

lastUpdatedBy.description: The email of the admin who last updated the policy.

UGCourse.title: UGCourse
UGCourse.description: Represents a course defined for a specific undergraduate year.

id.description: Unique identifier for the course entry.

courseCode.description: The unique code for the course (e.g., CS201).

courseName.description: The full name of the course.

weeklyHours.description: Total number of hours per week.

durationInSlots.description: How many timetable slots a single session takes (1 or 2).

createdBy.description: Identifier for who created the record.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the record was created.

UGSection.title: UGSection
UGSection.description: Defines the sections for a specific course.

createdBy.description: Identifier for who created the record.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the record was created.

UGElectiveBin.title: UGElectiveBin
UGElectiveBin.description: A bin of elective courses from which students can choose.

courses.description: Array of courseCodes belonging to this bin.

createdBy.description: Identifier for who created the record.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the record was created.

UGRoom.title: UGRoom
UGRoom.description: Represents a room available for a specific UG's classes.

createdBy.description: Identifier for who created the record.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the record was created.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore structure is designed to ensure authorization independence, clarity, and scalability for the CampusOS application, especially focusing on the Digital Medical & Document Approval System (Module 5). Key design considerations include denormalization for authorization, segregation of data based on access needs, and consistent access modeling.

**Authorization Independence and QAPs:**

*   **/users/{userId}/medicalRequests/{medicalRequestId}**: Medical requests are stored as subcollections under each user's document. This ensures that a student can only access their own requests, achieving path-based ownership and simplifies security rules.

*   **/doctors/{doctorId}/availability**: Doctor availability is stored in a separate collection, enabling easy querying and updates to doctor availability.  This ensures that students can see doctor availability in real-time.

*   **/users/{userId}/shortcuts/{shortcutId}**: User-defined shortcuts are stored in a subcollection under each user, ensuring that shortcuts are private and only visible to the user who created them.

*   **/resourceHub/students/{studentId}/resources/{resourceId}**: Student-specific resources are stored in a subcollection under a separate root collection, ensuring data privacy and ownership while keeping student documents clean.

**Structural Segregation:**

*   The data is separated based on access requirements:
    *   Student medical requests are stored under `/users/{userId}/medicalRequests/{medicalRequestId}`.
    *   Doctor availability statuses are stored in `/doctors/{doctorId}/availability`.
    *   Curriculum data is stored centrally in `/curriculums` to be queried by branch and year.
    *   Institute library books are stored in `/books`.
    *   Student personal library files are stored under `/students/{studentId}/library/{fileId}` to enforce privacy.
    *   Global resources are in a central, read-only collection `/globalResources`.

**Access Modeling:**

*   **Private Data (Student Medical Requests, User Shortcuts, Student Library, Student Resources):** Uses path-based ownership to ensure students can only access their own data.

*   **Role-Based Access Control:** The application logic determines roles based on email prefixes and domains (e.g., `doctor.name@iiits.in` for doctors). This allows for role-based access in the UI and application code.

This structure supports QAPs by:

*   Enabling secure `list` operations. For example, a student can securely list only their own medical requests because of the path-based ownership.
*   Providing clear segregation for different roles (student, doctor, director, academic office, librarian), which simplifies the implementation of Firestore security rules.
